description: The University of Virginia Biocomplexity team publishes a synthetic population for New Mexico in its SPW regional series. Zenodo lists a public data ZIP, README, contact matrix and validation graphics under CC BY 4.0. The README describes person and household CSVs, residence and activity-location tables, and assignments of activities to sites. It identifies IPUMS household data, GPW population counts, World Bank activity templates and OpenStreetMap-derived points of interest as inputs. These synthetic agents could define households and daytime destinations in a New Mexico evacuation or infrastructure-service access simulation. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this state release. A limitation is that the package was designed to model contacts, not observed traffic flows, building occupancy or emergency departure rates. Its coarse geography and default activity schedule need checking before using individual trips. The ZIP was not downloaded; row counts, road-network compatibility and upstream source conditions were not independently verified.
